description: This Java class implements an authentication handler for JWT tokens within the mockserver framework. It manages JWT validation, including handling JWK sources, and provides methods for setting expected claims and validating incoming HTTP requests with JWT tokens.

classes.name: JWTAuthenticationHandler
classes.description: A class that handles JWT authentication for HTTP requests, supporting configuration of expected claims and validation against JWK sources.

methods.name: JWTAuthenticationHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JWT validator with a JWK source, which can be a URL or a local file path.

methods.name: withExpectedAudience
methods.description: Sets the expected audience claim for JWT validation.

methods.name: withMatchingClaims
methods.description: Configures matching claims for JWT validation.

methods.name: withRequiredClaims
methods.description: Specifies required claims that must be present in the JWT.

methods.name: controlPlaneRequestAuthenticated
methods.description: Validates if an incoming HTTP request contains a valid JWT token in the Authorization header.

methods.name: logAuthorisationFailure
methods.description: Logs authorization failure details and throws an AuthenticationException.
